item.title: Garbally College past pupils donate €1,500 to charity from 50th anniversary reunion
item.description: Past pupils from Garbally College in Ballinasloe – marking 50 years since their graduation – have raised €1,500 for local charities and institutions on foot of their half-century celebration.
